output.explanation: Expanded terminal-state because geometry and font metrics concealed further derivations. Its central tree now separates retained state, decoded output, resize results, configuration mutations and local edits. Pulled out terminal-geometry and font-grid, connecting geometry directly to its font-metric input and preserving shared configuration/action references. Left data-core and child-io unchanged because their existing dependency trees remain useful at this scope. Preserved every existing edge, redirecting endpoints where concepts moved. Checked the pinned checkout: clarified saturating screen-minus-padding arithmetic, rounded font DPI versus unrounded padding DPI, primary-face metric calculation, balance-mode behavior, and distinct PTY versus cell-aligned terminal pixels. Added resize's synchronized-output reset and configuration-driven terminal mutations; distinguished persistent parsing state from optional replay-suffix tracking, which Termio does not enable.

    |                       |   `-- Compute: floor(configured points * axis DPI / 72)
    |                       |       (src/Surface.zig:447-466,2652-2665,3765-3800)
    |                       |       |-- [C] Per-side padding points (reference)
    |                       |       `-- Axis DPI = runtime content scale * platform default DPI
    |                       |           (72 on macOS, 96 otherwise; font/face.zig:29)
    |                       |-- [C] Balance mode (reference): false keeps explicit padding
    |                       `-- Balanced whitespace, for true/equal
    |                           `-- Compute: provisional grid from explicit padding;
    |                               each side = max(0, floor((screen - grid * cell) / 2))
    |                               true additionally caps top at (explicit left + right
    |                               + cell width) / 2, shifting excess to bottom;
    |                               equal keeps the symmetric split (size.zig:49-77,279-304)
    |                               `-- Explicit padding, screen and [B] cell pixels (references above)
    |-- PTY pixels = Size.terminal() = available pixels above (reference)
    |   -> May include a fractional-cell remainder; not necessarily grid * cell
    `-- Terminal.width_px/height_px = columns/rows * cell width/height (references)
        -> Terminal.resize saturates multiplication to u32 max; Termio.init sets initial pixels
